description: Assemble a small two-wheel scout robot: DC motors with wheels, a servo that turns an ultrasonic sensor, the controller board and its wiring; the battery is connected last, then the robot is switched on.

steps.instruction_es: Monta los dos motores en sus soportes, con el eje hacia afuera.
steps.completion_cue: both yellow gear motors held in their brackets on the chassis, shafts pointing outward

steps.instruction_es: Ahora encaja una rueda en el eje de cada motor.
steps.completion_cue: a wheel sits flush on each motor shaft

steps.instruction_es: Inserta el servo en su soporte, con el eje hacia arriba.
steps.completion_cue: the blue servo is in its bracket at the front, shaft pointing up

steps.instruction_es: Pon el brazo blanco en el eje del servo.
steps.completion_cue: a white plastic arm is fixed on the servo shaft

steps.instruction_es: Monta el sensor ultrasónico sobre el brazo del servo, con los ojos hacia adelante.
steps.completion_cue: the ultrasonic sensor sits on the servo arm, its two round eyes facing forward

steps.instruction_es: Atornilla la placa controladora sobre el chasis.
steps.completion_cue: the controller board is fixed on top of the chassis

steps.instruction_es: Conecta el cable del servo a la placa, con el cable café en GND.
steps.completion_cue: the servo's 3-pin connector is on the board's pins, brown wire on GND

steps.instruction_es: Conecta los cuatro cables del sensor a la placa.
steps.completion_cue: four jumper wires run from the sensor's pins to the board

steps.instruction_es: Ya está todo cableado: conecta el portapilas.
steps.completion_cue: the battery holder's red and black leads are connected

steps.instruction_es: Enciende el robot con el interruptor.
steps.completion_cue: the switch is on and an LED on the board is lit

mistakes.description: Connects the battery before all the wiring is finished.
mistakes.visual_cue: battery leads connected while sensor or servo wires are still loose
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, desconecta la batería: se conecta solo al final, cuando todo el cableado esté listo.

mistakes.description: Mounts the servo with its shaft pointing down.
mistakes.visual_cue: the servo sits in its bracket with the output shaft pointing down or into the chassis
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el servo quedó al revés: sácalo y ponlo con el eje hacia arriba.

mistakes.description: Plugs the servo connector in reversed.
mistakes.visual_cue: the servo connector is plugged in with the orange wire on the GND side
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, el cable del servo está invertido: dalo vuelta para que el café quede en GND.

mistakes.description: A wheel is only partly pushed onto the shaft.
mistakes.visual_cue: a wheel wobbles or leaves a visible gap to the motor
mistakes.correction_es: Ojo, la rueda quedó suelta: empújala hasta que toque el motor.
